title: 企業会計基礎
subtitle: Accounting Basic
educationalGoal: This course corresponds to the “Financial Ability” learning/education goal of the Faculty of Management Information. The goal is to have students understand the process of creating accounting information that contributes to the decision-making of management and corporate stakeholders, and to understand the content and role of financial statements, which are the means of conveying accounting information.
advice:
Companies record and aggregate the status of their activities using bookkeeping and provide accounting information to managers and stakeholders through financial statements.
In this course, students will learn the importance of financial statements as a tool for providing accounting information, as well as how to create and use them, after learning the “Bookkeeping cycle”.
By working a large number of exercises, students will develop appropriate bookkeeping and financial statement preparation/analysis skills.
Students should also be able to develop logical thinking skills that can be used to assess corporate activities based on monetary value.

requiredKnowledge: In this course, students will learn “bookkeeping,” a technology will be enable them to record and aggregate business activities using monetary values and to create accounting information that enables managers and stakeholders make informed decisions. In addition, students will learn the significance of financial statements as well as how to produce and use them as a means for disclosing accounting information. It is desirable that students be interested in the activities of companies to which the methodologies are applied and the economic environment surrounding these companies.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand assets, liabilities, capital, income, and expenses, and list specific item names.
Be able to understand bookkeeping procedures (journaling, posting, closing, preparing financial statements).
Be able to understand the concept of depreciation and have the ability to calculate depreciation expenses.
Be able to create a balance sheet and give an overview of the information that it displays.
Be able to create a profit and loss statement and give an overview of the information that it displays.

              This course corresponds to the “Financial Ability” learning/education goal of the Faculty of Management Information. The goal is to have students understand the process of creating accounting information that contributes to the decision-making of management and corporate stakeholders, and to understand the content and role of financial statements, which are the means of conveying accounting information.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Companies record and aggregate the status of their activities using bookkeeping and provide accounting information to managers and stakeholders through financial statements.
In this course, students will learn the importance of financial statements as a tool for providing accounting information, as well as how to create and use them, after learning the “Bookkeeping cycle”.
By working a large number of exercises, students will develop appropriate bookkeeping and financial statement preparation/analysis skills.
Students should also be able to develop logical thinking skills that can be used to assess corporate activities based on monetary value.
